approval: the owner's approval of the accepted evidence run, recorded by 'python -m stage1_calibration decide' (PR 39, Commit 2, Step 2A); takes effect when Commit 2 is created after local validation

policy.outer_folds: the same family in every outer fold; no per-fold or per-arm selection

evidence.verified: stage1_calibration check: recomputed exactly from the vectors
evidence.code_state: the Step 2A evidence code, before the policy change; its files are hashed in the evidence record

outcome.basis: C3 does not hold in both arms: the C2 default applies (C4)
outcome.statement: the family the registered conservative rule selects; not a claim that it is the better-calibrated family

interpretation: sigmoid is the family the registered conservative rule C1-C5 selects. Basis: C3 does not hold in both arms: the C2 default applies (C4). Isotonic replaces the sigmoid default only if it satisfies every C3 condition in both arms. Per arm: glass_lr: passed C3a, C3b, C3c, failed none; blackbox_mlp: passed none, failed C3a, C3b, C3c.
This is a policy selection, not a finding that sigmoid is the better-calibrated family in either arm.
In glass_lr the evidence favoured isotonic on every C3 condition. One family for both arms (C1) gives that up: the tradeoff the contract records in section 6.1.
The neutral alternative (D1) would select isotonic. It is reported for information and does not change the selection (C5).

neutral_alternative.definition: lower mean relative ΔBrier across the arms, sigmoid on ties (D1)
neutral_alternative.status: descriptive only (C5); does not change the selection

limitations: The Optuna hyperparameters are tuned once with all training labels; the out-of-fold probabilities are conditional on that tuning, equally for both families.
The bootstrap resamples rows with the fitted models held fixed, as in PR 38.
The historical per-arm selections were visible before the rule was frozen (contract F7); the rule was frozen with that exposure disclosed.
E-C used training rows only; the test split was not read.
